items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He [Les] was also on an album with a guy named Smitty Smith, one of the best drummers I’ve ever heard in my life.

ctx.x: Another one of your [Indiana University] faculty colleagues and a long-time friend of yours, Dominic Spera.

Dominic: another close friend. It’s important that he be here [in this interview], because the friendship extends so far back. Dominic was a wonderful trumpet player from Wisconsin. He was stationed at Fort Harrison in Indianapolis. He happened to be in the Army with Les Spann, the guy who played guitar and flute with Dizzy Gillespie and is on that one version of the – the only version of Dizzy Gillespie and Louis Armstrong in a studio on “The Jackie Gleason Show” – on the video. He [Les] was also on an album…
Another person who has a connection with Indiana University, but you go a lot farther back than that, and that’s Larry Ridley.
